type Weak = { x?: number };
class C {}
class D {
  static y = 1;
}
const fromClass: Weak = C;
const fromStatic: Weak = D;
const fromArrow: Weak = () => 1;
const fromIntersection: Weak & { y?: string } = C;
type T = { new (): object; x?: number };
const notCtor: T = { x: 1 };
console.log(fromClass, fromStatic, fromArrow, fromIntersection, notCtor);
